correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed all 17 open 8-vertex neighborhoods v+Q in Paley(17), with Q={1,2,4,8,9,13,15,16}; enumerated exactly 3,468 simplices and face vector (17,136,612,1122,952,476,136,17). Independent bit-column elimination produced all seven mod-2 boundary ranks (16,120,492,595,357,119,17). Each is a lower bound on the Q rank; the resulting Q Betti upper bounds vanish off degree 3, and reduced Euler −35 yields dim_Q H̃3=35. For every one of 136 affine maps v→av+b, recomputed sign of the permutation of each stable oriented face and alternating Lefschetz trace. Observed H3 character values 35 (identity), 1 (16 nonzero translations), 3 (17 elements of multiplier −1), −1 (102 remaining elements), agreeing on all elements with 2U⊕eta⊕J where eta(2)=−1, J(2)=matrix rotation i. Semisimple Q[G] characters determine the module. Independent standalone Python reconstruction is `/mnt/data/test_scope_2.py` and exited with PALEY17_INDEPENDENT_CHECK_OK. No integral module/lattice assertion follows from Q ranks.

value.rationale: Paley-17 is a canonical strongly regular graph with a natural Frobenius group of order 136. Its complete rational equivariant homology—including the counterintuitive absence of G-fixed classes and three-dimensional translation invariants—is an exact motivated object-specific invariant not encoded by ordinary homotopy type; reusable in equivariant chromatic/topological combinatorics.

limitations: Only this 17-vertex open-neighborhood complex and the specified affine subgroup; coefficients Q for representation.
Mod-2 ranks do not determine integral Smith invariants, which are not claimed.
